_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Simulation/Optimization Paper. Focuses on Power Allocation for DCO-OFDM FSO-ISAC to trade_off Spectral Efficiency and Sensing Precision (Fisher Information).

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: DCO-OFDM FSO-ISAC system model. Fig 3: Power allocation per subcarrier (Comm=Uniform, Sensing=High Freq). Fig 4: Trade-off curve (Spectral Efficiency vs Sensing Precision).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: FSO-ISAC. Waveform: DCO-OFDM (Intensity Modulation/Direct Detection). Optim: Power Allocation (Subcarrier Power + DC Bias). Metric: Spectral Efficiency vs Fisher Information (CRB).
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: ~4 bps/Hz spectral efficiency. Sensing: Precision constrained (e.g., 3.0 cm). Trade-off region 2.7-4.0 cm.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Numerical optimization study. Highlights the fundamental conflict in power allocation for OFDM ISAC: Comm prefers uniform/water-filling, Sensing prefers high-frequency subcarriers for better range resolution.

bibliographic.title: Power Allocation for OFDM-Based Free Space Optical Integrated Sensing and Communication
bibliographic.authors: Yunfeng Wen, Fang Yang, Jian Song, Zhu Han
bibliographic.venue: IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications (Likely, or similar)

application.scenario_description: FSO-ISAC transceiver (LiDAR-based) communicating with cooperative target while sensing.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Optimal power allocation algorithm for DCO-OFDM FSO-ISAC to maximize spectral efficiency under sensing precision constraints (Fisher Information).
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Trade-off analysis for resource allocation in optical OFDM ISAC waveforms, specifically power distribution across subcarriers.

integration.notes: Same waveform x(t) used for sensing (echo) and comm (transmission).

waveform.notes: DCO-OFDM. Power per subcarrier is the optimization variable.

comm_metrics.notes: Metric is Spectral Efficiency (bps/Hz). Reaches ~4 bps/Hz.

sensing_metrics.notes: Metric is Sensing Precision (CRB/Fisher Information). Analyzed for 2.7cm - 4.0cm precision.

tradeoff.notes: Clear pareto frontier. Comm prefers flat power. Sensing prefers high-freq power.
